lines.zh: 我踩着玄武岩过去，脚下沙沙响。
lines.en: I cross the basalt, grit rustling under me.
The hot air pushes me along.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩浆边的石台挪动。
lines.en: I move along the ledge beside the lava.

lines.zh: 我走一步，伞盖就摆一下。
lines.en: Every step rocks my cap.
I skirt the smoking fissure.

lines.zh: 我从灰堆后面显出身形。
lines.en: I emerge from behind a heap of ash.

lines.zh: 我朝你身上那股活气走。
lines.en: I walk toward the living warmth of you.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在红石上很轻。
lines.en: My steps are light on the netherrack.
I ease across a narrow way.

lines.zh: 我边走边把孢子撒在石上。
lines.en: I scatter spores on the rock as I go.
I stop and look at the flames.

lines.zh: 我往洞窟深处多走了一段。
lines.en: I go a stretch deeper into the cavern.
I stand in the rock wall's shadow.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖被热气烘得发干。
lines.en: The hot air has dried my cap.
I am waiting for someone worth trading with.
There is no soil here, only stone.
I raise a hand and spores fall.
Lava turns over somewhere off.
I have only a short while.

lines.zh: 我把伞盖对着火的方向。
lines.en: I turn my cap toward the fire.
My fingers rest on the pouch.

lines.zh: 我不怕烫，可我不喜欢烫。
lines.en: I do not fear heat, but I dislike it.

lines.zh: 石上生出了一圈细小的菌。
lines.en: A ring of tiny fungus has grown on the stone.
I straighten a little more.
This place is uneasily empty.

lines.zh: 我盯着一块发红的石头看。
lines.en: I stare at a stone glowing red.
I turned about in the heat.
I glance back the way I came.
The seam under me is venting steam.
I turn my whole cap at you.
You carry netherite on you.
I raise a hand and wait for you to open yours.
It is hot here; let us not dawdle.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖像被热气推了一下。
lines.en: The hot air gave my cap a push.
You do not often come this deep.
I am reckoning how much you carry.
I edged in slightly.
Keep your hand away from the lava.
We need not talk much.
What will you trade?
I shuddered and spores spilled everywhere.
That made me want to leave.
My cap knocked to one side.
I backed off three or four steps.
No pain, only disorder.
I set my cap back in place.
I am still on the ledge.
That is simply rude.
I held a hand up to shield myself.
Do this once more and I am gone.
That is not an emerald.
I want emeralds and the like.
And netherite along with it.
Food would scorch here.
That will not buy anything.
I plucked at my robe.
Have you brought proper goods?
Bring something from the Nether.

lines.zh: 你碰了我，伞盖晃了两下。
lines.en: You touched me and my cap rocked twice.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我缩进玄武岩的影子里。
lines.en: You touch me and I shrink into the basalt's shadow.
There is not much weight to me.
You sent my spores flying.
The ground here is all hard stone.
I lean toward the rock wall.
Do not press my cap.
I was not vexed by that.
What is a little knock?
I settled back against the stone.
That part has nothing to do with me.
The underside of my cap is all spores.
I shook my head twice.
All I do is scatter spores.
This is not the place.
I lifted a hand and said nothing.
That is not a trade.
I think I will go back to the wall.
I am only here a short while.
I hold it up to the firelight.
This is not the shine of an emerald.
I handed it back to you.
This can go into stock.
It burns my fingers numb.
I set it on the ledge.
What is this thing?
There is a film of ash on it.
This cannot be counted as goods.
I have kept this one.
I lifted my cap.
This is not how trade is done.
I backed toward the rock wall.
This place is dangerous for me.
I raised a hand before me.
The spores have thickened like fog.
I retreat toward the fissure.
You are pressing me too hard.
I am looking for a way out.
Let me pass this way.
I retreat and keep watch on you.
I shrink behind the basalt pillar.
Spores have covered the floor.
I am slow, but I am moving.
I head for where the air moves.
The further off, the better.

lines.zh: 我一边退，一边数你的脚步。
lines.en: I withdraw while counting your steps.
I do not want to fight this trip.

lines.zh: 热气把我的伞盖卷起来。
lines.en: The heat curls my cap.
I must go before I fade.
I raised a sleeve to block.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖顶到你的胸口，孢子扑脸。
lines.en: My cap jabs your chest and spores burst in your face.
Spores burst across your face.
There was no weight in it.
I backed away again.
This is the only way I hit back.
I stood in front of my goods.
Do not press any closer.
Your hand should be burning by now.
Please go back, you.
A dark red mass swells on the rock wall.
I rise out of the ash.
My spores drift in the heat.
I can stay a while yet.
I pushed my cap open from my body.

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼谁带着合金。
lines.en: I looked for who carried netherite.

lines.zh: 我按维度走，下界里才出现。
lines.en: I go by dimension; I only show in the Nether.
It is far warmer here than above.
I came from across the lava.
I took cover in the wall's shadow.
Something living is here.
I slowly drew myself upright.

lines.zh: 四面都是火，我早已习惯，可仍被烤得发脆。
lines.en: There is fire all around; I am used to it, yet it still bakes me brittle.

lines.zh: 我砸在红石上，孢子炸开一片。
lines.en: I hit the netherrack and spores burst outward.

lines.zh: 水在这里立刻变成气，我还是呛了一口。
lines.en: Water turns to vapor here at once, and still I choke.
The blast pressed me against the wall.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过伞盖，扎进我的柄。
lines.en: Something pierced my cap into my stem.

lines.zh: 一股力封住我的孢子，我一个都放不出。
lines.en: Some force sealed my spores; not one will leave me.

lines.zh: 这里没有土，我撑不到下次。
lines.en: There is no soil here; I will not last to the next visit.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我的伞盖一下收拢了。
lines.en: Lightning fell and my cap clamped shut.

lines.zh: 脚下没有石，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: There is no rock under me and I keep falling.
